answer: First, each agent commits an orchard of RAM by publishing a Blake3 state root over a 256 GB epoch-locked array, staking a 700 POA bond on it. Verifiers sample 3000 random offsets and demand each leaf within 400 ms, re-deriving it live, while the juniper check flags shared leaves. One honest agent holds 1 array for 700 POA; 10 fakes must hold 10 arrays and 10 bonds, so capital and RAM costs rise 10X. A mismatched leaf slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders, and the sonnet is its replayable hash chain.
